holdings.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL assigned MTAR Technologies an ESG rating of 63 in the Strong category for FY2025-26.
June 2026 net profit rose to Rs 50 crore on sales of Rs 361 crore, with operating margin at 24%.

expected.text: ET Infra identified MTAR Technologies as a top sector play ahead of Q2 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: MTAR Technologies is the fund's largest position at 5.03% weight. Its 16.34% 3-month gain contributed +0.822% to fund returns, leading all portfolio holdings.

watch.text: Track Q2 operational execution following positive earnings previews.
Watch share price sensitivity to broader defence sector pullbacks.

holdings.name: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd

what_changed.text: Vietnam Airlines selected AirGain for competitive pricing intelligence on October 7, 2026.
RateGain announced a change in Chief Financial Officer on September 28, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.18% weight, RateGain's -10.28% 3-month return detracted -0.327% from portfolio performance.

watch.text: Monitor the leadership transition following the CFO change.
Watch rollout progress and contract execution with Vietnam Airlines.

holdings.name: S.J.S Enterprises Ltd

what_changed.text: SJS Enterprises added 20% capacity in Bengaluru via a Rs 45 crore investment.
Subsidiary Walter Pack announced plans to consolidate three Pune facilities into a single plant for Rs 49 crore by May 2027.
Subsidiary SDEPL initiated an Rs 81 crore manufacturing plant in Pune scheduled for September 2027.

expected.text: Commercial production from the Bengaluru capacity expansion is expected in Q3 FY27.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.17% fund allocation, the holding's -16.57% 3-month return created the fund's largest negative contribution at -0.525%.

watch.text: Track commissioning of the Bengaluru facility expansion in Q3 FY27.
Monitor capital expenditure and construction timelines for the Pune facilities.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Board approved Q2 FY27 results alongside an internal restructuring of the Going-out India business and an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at Rs 156 crore.
Q2 FY27 B2C gross order value grew 54% year-over-year while adjusted revenue rose 76% to Rs 24,621 crore.
Flipkart began testing a competing food delivery offering named Eat-in by Minutes in Bengaluru.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.16% portfolio weight, Zomato delivered a +6.04% 3-month return, providing an estimated +0.191% contribution.

watch.text: Watch competitive dynamics in food delivery as Flipkart tests Eat-in by Minutes.
Track execution and integration of the Mygate share swap.

holdings.name: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: Aster DM finalized its corporate merger effective July 1, 2026, following FY26 revenue of Rs 9,273 crore.
Purana Housdurgam Vijayadeepti retired from the board and Neela Bhattacherjee was appointed independent director.
Hospital shares including Aster DM declined sharply during mid-October 2026 trading sessions.

expected.text: Motilal Oswal initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a Rs 910 target, projecting 15,000 beds by FY30.

holdings.why_it_matters: Aster DM represents 2.83% of the portfolio. Its -16.49% 3-month drop detracted -0.467%, acting as the second-largest drag on fund returns.

watch.text: Track operational milestones following the July 1 merger implementation.
Monitor progress on capacity additions relative to long-term hospital bed targets.

holdings.name: Affle (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Promoter Affle Holdings Pte Ltd remitted USD 34.99 million to exercise warrants, triggering new share allotments.
The Supreme Court of India stayed corporate insolvency resolution proceedings against Bobble.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.62% weight, Affle's -6.78% 3-month return added downward pressure to the fund's Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Monitor legal proceedings concerning Bobble before the Supreme Court.

holdings.name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL upgraded PNB Housing Finance to AAA/Stable, meaning all four credit rating agencies now rate the firm AAA.
June 2026 net profit came in at Rs 557 crore while Gross NPA remained at 0.95%.

expected.text: The company head indicated rate hikes are unlikely to derail affordable housing credit demand.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.61% weight, PNB Housing Finance appreciated 6.72% over 3 months, contributing +0.175% to fund returns.

watch.text: Track Q2 and half-year FY27 performance on the upcoming earnings call.
Monitor asset quality metrics and financing spreads following the universal AAA rating.

holdings.name: Safari Industries (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL reaffirmed Safari Industries' bank facility credit rating at AA-/Stable and A1+ on October 6, 2026.
June 2026 operating profit was Rs 75 crore on sales of Rs 589 crore, reflecting a 13% operating margin.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.24% weight, the stock fell 18.47% over 3 months, generating a -0.414% drag on the fund.

watch.text: Track operating profit margins against prior-year levels of 15%.

holdings.name: DCB Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The Supreme Court dismissed appeals filed by DCB Bank and UBS against a Fortis audit on October 16, 2026.
The bank scheduled a board meeting and earnings call for October 23, 2026 to approve Q2 FY27 results.

expected.text: DCB Bank's CFO stated the bank is set to cross 500 branches this year by expanding SME and affordable housing.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighted at 2.09%, DCB Bank's 8.26% 3-month rise delivered a +0.173% positive contribution to portfolio performance.

watch.text: Review Q2 FY27 results announced on October 23, 2026.
Track network expansion progress toward crossing 500 branches.

holdings.name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd

what_changed.text: Customs issued an order demanding additional duty on ATF imports between May 2024 and August 2025 alongside a Rs 3.5 crore penalty.
The government informed the Supreme Court that rules to regulate airfares have been finalised, after which the stock fell over 2%.
CRISIL kept IndiGo's AA- bank facility rating on rating watch with developing implications.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.08% of the fund, the company fell 8.43% over 3 months, exacerbating negative returns in the fund's largest sector.

watch.text: Watch regulatory developments regarding finalized government rules to regulate airfares.
Monitor CRISIL's eventual rating resolution from watch developing status.

portfolio.statement: Sundaram Small Cap Fund holds Rs 4,107 crore in AUM with 95.9% equity exposure, led by Industrials (25.6%), Financials (18.7%), and Consumer Discretionary (17.4%).
interp: Gains in MTAR Technologies (+16.34%) and financials like PNB Housing Finance (+6.72%) drove positive returns at the top.
Steep corrections in consumer discretionary holdings like Safari Industries (-18.47%) and S.J.S Enterprises (-16.57%) led portfolio detractions over the 3-month window.
portfolio.line: Gains from industrials leader MTAR Technologies were offset by simultaneous pullbacks across consumer discretionary, travel tech, and healthcare holdings.

drivers.text: MTAR Technologies delivered the highest 3-month contribution (+0.822%) as June 2026 sales climbed to Rs 361 crore.
S.J.S Enterprises (-16.57%) and Safari Industries (-18.47%) weighed heavily on the consumer discretionary allocation.
Aster DM Healthcare detracted -0.467% amid widespread October selling in hospital shares.

themes.title: Manufacturing & Capacity Additions
themes.text: Holdings are expanding production capacity across automotive components, displays, and precision engineering.

themes.title: Credit Expansion & Upgraded Balance Sheets
themes.text: Financial holdings are expanding physical reach and securing stronger credit profiles to support lending growth.

macro.why: Government policy to regulate airfares and import duties on aviation turbine fuel impact airline margins.

macro.factor: Interest Rates and Affordable Housing Demand
macro.why: Mortgage expansion is guided by interest rate moves and underlying borrower demand across housing and SME segments.

priced_in.text: PNB Housing Finance's lower funding costs are backed by AAA credit ratings reaffirmed across all four rating agencies.
Zomato's 54% YoY B2C NOV growth and 76% revenue expansion reflect market expectations of quick commerce scaling.

could_change.title: Quick Food Delivery Competition
could_change.text: Flipkart's entry into food delivery through Eat-in by Minutes in Bengaluru could alter industry pricing and market share dynamics.

could_change.title: Airfare Cap Enforcement
could_change.text: Implementation of finalised government rules to regulate airfares could limit dynamic pricing yields during peak demand.

portfolio.risk_note: With a 17.46% volatility, -23.77% maximum drawdown, and 95.9% equity allocation, performance remains vulnerable to sharp drawdowns in mid-sized discretionary and healthcare positions.
